he was one. He had two trombone players. At one time I had Fernando Venis'cia. Mexican fella that I had put in with me with Noble Sissle on the west coast. I sent for Fernando and Fernando came and joined us when I was with Jeter-Pillars.
It becomes a small world in the world of musicians sometimes.
